overview: Guide homeowners through claim filing, present the contingency agreement, execute claim authorization, and prepare for adjuster meetings with confidence.
learningObjectives: Present contingency agreements clearly and close professionally
Set expectations and prepare for adjuster meetings

sections.title: Information Gathering
sections.content: Collect: name, contacts, address, carrier/policy, deductible (if known), preferred contact, app/website access. Script: ‘First I’ll grab some basic information for our system.’

sections.title: Contingency Agreement Presentation
sections.content: Position: rep present at inspection; carriers mitigate losses. Risk‑free guarantee: only cost is deductible if fully approved; if not fully approved, contract is null and void (no payment). Value: we want to do the work if we achieve full approval.

sections.title: Claim Authorization
sections.content: Authorizes Roof‑ER to communicate with carrier; removes homeowner as middle‑person; CC homeowner on all emails and updates.

sections.title: Adjuster Meeting Prep
sections.content: Adjuster will contact in 24–48 hours; rep presence required; avoid Tuesday mornings; ideally have adjuster call rep to schedule.

activities.title: Collecting Info
activities.description: Practice collecting info professionally — handle missing deductible and multiple policies.

prompts.expectedResponse: Reassure and proceed; note to confirm later

activities.title: Risk‑Free Close
activities.description: Deliver the full contingency script and handle objections.

data.scenario: Explain guarantee and value, then close for signature.

quiz.explanation: No payment if not fully approved.
